title: Home Oxygen Therapy Records Note — A Stay Already Showing on the Patient's Other Summit Ridge Rentals
content:
# A Stay Already Showing on Another Rental — Home Oxygen Therapy

**Rule.** A stay that already shows on another Summit Ridge rental of the patient dates the Home Oxygen Therapy suspension from that record, while the oxygen record is an active rental. The evidence day is:

1. when the patient's PAP Therapy Equipment device record is suspended with a suspension date later than the oxygen setup date, that PAP suspension date;
2. otherwise, when the patient's Hospital Beds & Support Surfaces bed record is suspended, the bed's suspension date;
3. otherwise, the day the stay is reported.

The suspension is dated from the evidence day.

## Records read

| Record | What is read |
|---|---|
| the oxygen record | whether it is an active rental, and its setup date |
| the patient's PAP Therapy Equipment device record | whether it is suspended, and its suspension date |
| the patient's Hospital Beds & Support Surfaces bed record | whether it is suspended, and its suspension date |

## Judgement table

| Oxygen record an active rental | PAP device record suspended, with a suspension date later than the oxygen setup date | Bed record suspended | Evidence day |
|---|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | either | the PAP suspension date |
| yes | no | yes | the bed's suspension date |
| yes | no | no | the day the stay is reported |
| no | — | — | the day the stay is reported |

A PAP device record that is suspended with a suspension date on or before the oxygen setup date does not supply the evidence day; the bed record is then considered.

## Cases (hypothetical dates)

- Oxygen setup date 2 January; PAP device record suspended from 18 March; stay reported 25 March. The evidence day is 18 March.
- Oxygen setup date 2 January; PAP device record suspended from 20 December of the year before; bed record suspended from 19 March; stay reported 25 March. The PAP date is not later than the setup date, so the evidence day is 19 March, the bed's suspension date.
- No other rental of the patient is suspended; stay reported 25 March. The evidence day is 25 March.
